text.en:
LEGAL PROFESSION ACT (CHAPTER 132) NOTIFICATION MADE UNDER SECTION 17(2)(a) GN 2/2002 2006 Edition

REVISED EDITION 2022

LAWS OF BRUNEI Legal Profession CAP. 132, N 4 3 [Subsidiary]

SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION Notification made under section 17(2)(a) In exercise of the powers conferred by section 17(2)(a), His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby declares the office of Legal Officer in the Attorney General’s Chambers to be an office to which that subsection applies, from the 20th day of December 2001.
